_comment: Application protection sets (protsets.py). sets: [{id, app (the software list's name), rules: [{id, default (ticked), needs (packages the rule is about, for the page), spec (a confident block without host: target, header, arg, regex, exceptions, msg, reference, source), tests (sandbox requests: path, method, headers, body, expect 403|200, source external|internal; the site is filled in), refs (sources), cves}]}]. Titles and explanations are UI strings protset.r.<set>.<rule> / protset.w.<set>.<rule>. Every rule is written from public information or measured on a real DSM (see refs; the QNAP, Nextcloud and Zimbra sets are written from public write-ups and the sources, checked in a real nginx + ModSecurity 3.0.9 / 3.0.17 + CRS 4.30 sandbox); tests/test_protsets.py checks each attack test matches its rule and each ordinary test does not.
